radiusSource: Radius 1.127 (1.104 to 1.149) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 783,908 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.968 (0.928 to 1.008) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1692267077979468544: teff_gspphot 5727.5093 K (16th-84th percentiles 5726.456-5728.7827), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1692267077979468544: teff_gspphot 5727.5093 K (16th-84th percentiles 5726.456-5728.7827), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
